description: This file contains utility functions for verifying the URL resolution for the /api/users endpoint within a frontend codebase. It provides functions to construct expected URLs with organization context, log them for verification, and simulate specific organization resolutions for testing purposes.

methods.name: verifyUsersUrlResolution(organizationIdOverride = null)
methods.description: Constructs and logs the expected resolution URL for the /api/users endpoint, optionally overriding the organization ID for testing scenarios.

methods.name: quickUsersResolutionSmoke()
methods.description: Performs a quick, logged resolution check for a specific organization ID ('T0015') without mutating state.
